study: Loughran-McDonald dictionary addition to already-inspected fixed 2023 development comparisons; not a blind test or alpha confirmation
meaning: Official Milestone 2 explicitly specifies Loughran-McDonald dictionary; LM does not mean a generic language-model comparator here

source.license_scope: Official page permits free academic research; local MSML610 academic comparison only. Commercial Quant.ai deployment and redistribution are not authorized by this experiment. No explicit legal acceptance, credentials or paid access used.
source.historical_lexicon_availability: Current 2025 dictionary retrieved 2026, postdates 2023 sample. Use current positive category flags; do not claim reconstruction of a 2023 as-of dictionary.

score.tokenization: ASCII letter runs [A-Za-z]+, uppercase, discard length <2; no stemming, lemmatization, stopword removal or negation rules
score.active_category: Integer Positive or Negative flag >0 in the current CSV; zero and negative (removed) flags are inactive. No inferred backdating from category-year fields.
score.headline_score: (positive token occurrences - negative token occurrences) / all retained token occurrences; repeated words counted; score bounded [-1,1]
score.no_polarity_hit: With retained tokens but no positive/negative hits, use numeric zero and explicit NoPolarityMatch diagnostic; this is not independently verified neutral tone. Do not remove these rows.
score.aggregation: Recover exact original headlines from source_row_indices, deduplicate identical titles preserving first-seen order as the FinBERT input budget, verify newline-joined text equals saved company-day text, then arithmetic mean of headline scores; no URL/company-name filtering
score.unavailable: Any missing/invalid source title or zero-token headline makes that company-day unavailable; if any train or test row of a case is unavailable, mark both added LM controls Unavailable for the whole case. Keep every existing baseline row/model; never intersect on LM coverage.
score.additional_categories: Master-word match, positive/negative counts, token counts and zero-hit coverage are diagnostics only; no other dictionary categories enter calibration

calibration.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on training rows only, separate by company/horizon/target/pool

sample_policy: Exactly reuse each registered prior case train/test ordered IDs; common pool remains eligibility-only intersection already fixed across horizons. No source retrieval, repricing, selective removal or baseline refit. Prior outcomes already inspected.
metrics: paired absolute losses versus existing controls, descriptive only
cost_policy: Reuse original non-overlap interval IDs per case; long company if predicted selected target >0 else cash; preserve always-company/SPY/cash. Original costs are assumed execution bps, not actual charges. Raw/excess targets both exclude dividends; execution-time certification false; no pooled company capital curve or horizon selection.
strict_total_return_track: Unchanged, zero eligible labels inherited; no historical capture timestamps invented
